title: Context word
statement: For a nondeterministic finite-state machine $N$ and natural numbers $c$, $B$, and $e$, the context word associated with a Boolean list $x$ is the pair encoding of $x$ together with the pair encoding of the radius determined by $c$ and $x$ and the $W$-codes determined by $B$, $e$, and $x$.
caveat: The formal snippet does not provide definitions for the pair encoding, radius, or $W$-codes, so their precise mathematical meanings cannot be stated here.
